note: BD-1315 biome kits (docs/250 S2): desert, tundra, volcano and the jungle ledge. Style guides: ChatGPT sheets (sheet-*-chatgpt.jpg) made from the approved vegetation v2 sheet and the biome grid; meshes = Roblox Studio generate_mesh with prompts written from those sheets, published to the owner's account 2026-11-23. tris = real face count (EditableMesh). Every piece checked close up in Studio under the owner's cohesion rule (docs/250 s8); rejects below. Owner 2026-11-23 second note: no stone rings or ground discs at plant bases, plant each biome like nature; all plants were regenerated with clean bases (clean-*.jpg) and KitDensity thins the small plants per biome. Rocks and spires sink 12% into the terrain (PropGround.RockSink), which buries a thin rim.
